title: XL Sound of Love Waveform Sculpture
description:
Sound of Love Sculpture
– Capture The Timeless Echo of Eternal Love

The Sound of Love is a celebration of love transformed into art. Inspired by the vibration of the eternal phrase "I love you," this piece transcends language to capture the intangible essence of connection. It stands as a visual symphony of emotion, fusing contemporary design with heartfelt meaning.

Crafted with a hand-cast concrete base, the piece is created with 3D-printed PLA, adds a modern elegance. The interplay of textures and materials invites contemplation and tactile exploration, making it more than just a decorative object—it’s a conversation piece, a sentiment, and a memory encapsulated.

This sculpture’s minimalist aesthetic allows it to harmonize with diverse spaces, from serene, minimalist interiors to eclectic, art-filled homes. Perfectly sized for intimate spaces such as desks, shelves, or nightstands, it serves as a daily reminder of love’s boundless beauty.

A Timeless Gift: Whether as a personal treasure or a gift for someone dear, the Soundwave Love Sculpture embodies the art of connection. It’s ideal for marking special occasions such as Valentine's Day, anniversaries, or weddings, offering a meaningful and enduring expression of love.

Specifications

Materials: 
- Recycled starch-based plastic (PLA)
- Cement Base
- Stainless Steel 

Dimensions: 8in x 8in x 21in

***Estimated production time is 3-7 days. Product will start shipping after production is complete. Each stand is made-to-order (made after we receive the order).

Terms & Conditions

The Sound of Love creations are 3D printed layer-by-layer, which allows it to achieve detailed, intricate shapes that would have been very difficult to produce with other manufacturing methods, all while accomplishing this with very little waste.

While 3D printing is automated, it isn’t a 100% perfect process, as it is not mass production. So each 3D print is unique and one of a kind, slightly different from one another. As a result, there may be variations in texture & shape, especially between different batches of materials. These variations do not affect the functionality or overall aesthetic of the final product.

*Please note that each product is one-of-a-kind. Colors will vary slightly from the picture.

*Please note that the material used to print this product is sustainable starch based plastic which has a low temperature resistance. Keep away from heating sources and fire.

title: Sound of Love Waveform Sculpture
description:
Sound of Love Sculpture
– Capture The Timeless Echo of Eternal Love

The Sound of Love is a celebration of love transformed into art. Inspired by the vibration of the eternal phrase "I love you," this piece transcends language to capture the intangible essence of connection. It stands as a visual symphony of emotion, fusing contemporary design with heartfelt meaning.

Crafted with a hand-cast concrete base, the piece is created with 3D-printed PLA, adds a modern elegance. The interplay of textures and materials invites contemplation and tactile exploration, making it more than just a decorative object—it’s a conversation piece, a sentiment, and a memory encapsulated.

This sculpture’s minimalist aesthetic allows it to harmonize with diverse spaces, from serene, minimalist interiors to eclectic, art-filled homes. Perfectly sized for intimate spaces such as desks, shelves, or nightstands, it serves as a daily reminder of love’s boundless beauty.

A Timeless Gift: Whether as a personal treasure or a gift for someone dear, the Soundwave Love Sculpture embodies the art of connection. It’s ideal for marking special occasions such as Valentine's Day, anniversaries, or weddings, offering a meaningful and enduring expression of love.

Specifications

Materials: 
- Recycled starch-based plastic (PLA)
- Cement Base
- Stainless Steel 

Dimensions: 4in x 4in x 10.5in

***Estimated production time is 3-7 days. Product will start shipping after production is complete. Each stand is made-to-order (made after we receive the order).

Terms & Conditions

The Sound of Love creations are 3D printed layer-by-layer, which allows it to achieve detailed, intricate shapes that would have been very difficult to produce with other manufacturing methods, all while accomplishing this with very little waste.

While 3D printing is automated, it isn’t a 100% perfect process, as it is not mass production. So each 3D print is unique and one of a kind, slightly different from one another. As a result, there may be variations in texture & shape, especially between different batches of materials. These variations do not affect the functionality or overall aesthetic of the final product.

*Please note that each product is one-of-a-kind. Colors will vary slightly from the picture.

*Please note that the material used to print this product is sustainable starch based plastic which has a low temperature resistance. Keep away from heating sources and fire.
